note: Part motions for the trainer idle (utils/trainerMotion.js). Poké Balls detected by tools/detect-trainer-parts.mjs and each reviewed close-up (rest vs lifted at 6×); Epic+ wind sways and blinks hand-placed on zoomed grids and reviewed. Epic+ blinks: eyes proposed by a detector or placed by hand on labelled grids, every one checked open vs closed; 38 Epic+ sprites have no blinkable eyes (masks, silhouettes, sunglasses, hat shadow, eyes drawn closed). Rects are [x0,y0,x1,y1] in sprite pixels; d is the 1-px move; a sway moves only the rows from `from` (0 = rect top, 1 = bottom) down; a blink closes each eye rect in `eyes`; at is the fraction of the loop; ms is how long it holds. Generation consolidation (2026-11-11) removed entries for folded files (data/sprites/trainer-consolidation.json); their groups keep their own sprite.
